copy.headline: Fort Worth commission provides update on city strategies to curb homelessness
copy.caption:
The city programs highlighted use $7 million of general and state funds to target homeless status among different demographics. The city outlined its current strategies in curbing homelessness during a Human Relations Commission meeting earlier this month.

Highlighted initiatives include the Rapid Exit, High Impact and Flower Brewer Bridge programs. The city has $7 million in general and state funds to allow flexibility and piloting of innovative programs.

Highlighted initiatives include the Rapid Exit, High Impact and Flower Brewer Bridge programs. The city has $7 million in general and state funds to allow flexibility and piloting of innovative programs. The city’s approach involves a spectrum of services, collaborative partnerships, data-driven reporting, targeted interventions for different and vulnerable populations, and a strong emphasis on leveraging funding and community involvement.
